name: jaa compact
description: Dense one-page CV for senior and lead profiles: name and headline beside a right-aligned contact block, one line per role with organization, location and dates, tight bullet points. TeX Gyre Heros Condensed, 10pt, narrow margins, A4 (US Letter: one class option).
license: MIT (this repository). Uses only packages and fonts from standard TeX distributions: titlesec, needspace, etoolbox (LPPL) and TeX Gyre Heros Condensed (GUST Font License).
